fields.summary_ko.0: Tesla (TSLA) at current $380 down 15% year-to-date; reaching $600 target requires 58% gain while Wall Street average target suggests only 9% gain.
fields.summary_ko.1: FSD subscriptions increased from 1.04 million to 1.74 million and Robotaxi expected to be significant revenue source in Q3–Q4, though Q3 operating profit plummeted 56% and R&D increased from $1.63B to $2.76B.
